domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record could be retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India sales splits were not accessible: tofler.in returned HTTP 403, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, and the web_search backend was down ('searx: Connection refused') for every query attempted, so no GST/tender page could be located. Domestic supply is therefore neither confirmed nor ruled out — null, not public in the sources reachable.
note: Declared HS 910599 and industry 'IT и электроника' are wrong: every customs row seen is Indian black tea under HS 09023020 (tea, black, in packings <=3 kg), and the company is a Kolkata/Darjeeling tea exporter, not electronics. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — verdict accepted_hs_corrected, actual HS 09023020. Role: manufacturer_trader (buys from Mabroc Teas / Yiwu Xinyi for packaging inputs, sells own Golden Tips branded tea). Export side is factually confirmed with dated B/Ls to Japan, Russia and China, most recent 2026-02-27. Domestic side: 'следов поставок не найдено' in accessible sources — no GST band or tender record obtained, so domestic_status is unknown rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in free views. PAN AABCG2434N was claimed by the requester and was not independently verified (registry lookups blocked); CIN not verified.
